abstract: Using a global dyadic panel from 1950 to 2021, we find a positive association between arms transfers from an exporter to an importer and general goods exports to that partner. The effects are short‐run: export responses peak around the transfer and fade within a few years. The arms‐trade linkage is smaller among highly institutionalized, high‐income partnerships and larger where security and commerce are more tightly bundled, especially in dyads linked by overseas military presence. Consistent with a political‐alignment channel, arms transfers are followed by lower United Nations voting disagreement. The associated trade increase does not reflect a symmetric improvement in relations.
abstract_zh: 利用1950年至2021年的全球双边面板数据，我们发现，出口国向进口国转让武器与该伙伴国的一般商品出口之间存在正相关关系。这种效应是短期的：出口反应在转让前后达到峰值，并在几年内逐渐消退。在高度制度化、高收入伙伴关系中，武器贸易关联度较小；而在安全与商业联系更为紧密的情况下，尤其是在存在海外军事存在的双边关系中，这种关联度则更大。与政治结盟渠道一致，武器转让后联合国投票分歧有所减少。相关的贸易增长并不反映双边关系的对称性改善。
china_relevance_reason: 研究基于1950-2021年全球双边面板数据，分析军火转让对贸易的影响，未聚焦中国、中国企业或中国制度背景，作者姓名不构成判定依据。
title: Guns for butter: Trade effects of arms transfers
title_zh: 枪支换黄油：武器转让的贸易效应

abstract: This article posits the contradictory relation between capitalist and non-capitalist segments of an economy as a key dimension of the colonial encounter and as a critical and constitutive element in the contemporary process of postcolonial capitalist development. It points to the obfuscation of this contradiction in the prevalent theoretical approaches in development economics, particularly focusing on the discourse on informal economy and the role of identity. It then foregrounds an emerging theoretical framework on postcolonial economic dynamics — and its key methodological tenets — that frames the development process as being marked by this on-going and ever-occurring contradiction. The article, however, highlights a key gap in this framework to grapple with the role of identities in these development dynamics, and points to some critical methodological approaches to identity that may be productively integrated to further develop it. Finally, the article provides empirical illustrations from the Indian context that underscores the constitutive role of caste in shaping both the reproduction of non-capitalist informal enterprises that sustain the working populations excluded from the capitalist segments, as well as the selective inclusion of parts of this population into capitalist segments as informal wage labor — processes that can be generatively interpreted through the above theoretical framework. Through this intervention, the article aims to clear grounds towards formulating a pathway to build a decolonized approach to contemporary processes of economic development.
abstract_zh: 本文提出，经济中资本主义与非资本主义部分之间的矛盾关系，是殖民遭遇的一个关键维度，也是当代后殖民资本主义发展进程中一个批判性和构成性的要素。文章指出，发展经济学中流行的理论方法对此矛盾的模糊处理，尤其聚焦于非正式经济话语及身份角色的讨论。随后，文章凸显了一个关于后殖民经济动态的新兴理论框架及其关键方法论原则，该框架将发展过程视为被这一持续且不断发生的矛盾所标记。然而，文章也指出了该框架在处理身份在这些发展动态中作用方面的一个关键空白，并提出了一些关于身份的关键方法论途径，这些途径可能被富有成效地整合以进一步发展该框架。最后，文章提供了来自印度背景的实证例证，强调了种姓在塑造非资本主义非正式企业再生产中的构成性作用，这些企业维持着被排除在资本主义部分之外的劳动人口，以及部分该人口作为非正式工资劳动力被选择性纳入资本主义部分的过程——这些过程可以通过上述理论框架进行生成性解读。通过这一介入，文章旨在为构建一种去殖民化的当代经济发展过程方法铺平道路。
title: Development economics and the colonial encounter: Informality, caste, and postcolonial capitalist development in India
title_zh: 发展经济学与殖民遭遇：印度的非正式性、种姓与后殖民资本主义发展

abstract: We show how clustering standard errors in one or more dimensions can be justified in M-estimation when there is sampling or assignment uncertainty. Since existing procedures for variance estimation are either conservative or invalid, we propose a variance estimator that refines a conservative procedure and remains valid. We then interpret environments where clustering is frequently employed in empirical work from our design-based perspective and provide insights on their estimands and inference procedures.
abstract_zh: 我们展示了在M估计中，当存在抽样或分配不确定性时，如何在一个或多个维度上对标准误进行聚类是合理的。鉴于现有的方差估计程序要么保守要么无效，我们提出了一种方差估计器，它改进了保守程序并保持有效性。随后，我们从基于设计的视角解读了实证工作中频繁采用聚类的环境，并对其估计目标及推断程序提供了见解。
title: Clustering with potential multidimensionality: Inference and practice
title_zh: 多维潜聚类：推断与实践

abstract: A large portion of the developing world has pursued big-push industrialization to promote growth over the past century. This paper utilizes a quasi-experimental design to investigate the long-term impact of such programs. From 1950 to 1959, the Soviet Union sent thousands of experts, engineers, and machinery to China to aid with the first Five-Year Plan of national development and to help establish a network of state-owned industrial plants across China. This massive program was brought to an abrupt standstill following the Sino-Soviet split in the early 1960s. This paper takes the unforeseen termination of the Soviet projects as an exogenous shock and investigates its impact on local economic development in the long run. Counties with more Soviet projects completed by the 1960s are shown to have larger state sectors today and, surprisingly, also enjoy better developmental outcomes overall and in the private sector in particular. Five mechanisms are examined as potential causes. I find no evidence of innovation spillover or differential infrastructure, but strong support for human capital externality and agglomeration through production networks. Resource allocation also continues to favor these localities: even private businesses in counties with more Soviet projects enjoy better access to the financial market.
abstract_zh: 过去一个世纪里，发展中世界的很大一部分地区推行了大推进工业化以促进增长。本文利用准实验设计来考察此类项目的长期影响。1950年至1959年间，苏联派遣了数千名专家、工程师并输送机械设备至中国，协助实施第一个五年国家发展计划，并帮助在中国各地建立国有工业工厂网络。然而，这一大规模项目在20世纪60年代初因中苏分裂而骤然中断。本文将苏联项目的意外终止视为外生冲击，考察其对地方经济的长期影响。研究发现，截至20世纪60年代完成更多苏联项目的县，如今国有部门规模更大，且令人意外的是，这些地区整体发展成果更佳，尤其是私营部门表现更为突出。本文考察了五种可能的机制，未发现创新溢出或基础设施差异的证据，但人力资本外部性和通过生产网络形成的集聚效应得到了有力支持。资源配置也持续偏向这些地区：即便在苏联项目较多的县，私营企业也能获得更好的金融市场准入机会。
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: Legacy of Soviet-aided industrialization in China: A quasi-experiment
title_zh: 苏联援华工业化的遗产：一项准实验研究

abstract: This paper examines how participation in global value chains (GVCs) shapes inflation in the European Union over 1995–2023. Using local projections, we trace the dynamic response of producer- and consumer-price inflation to total, backward, and forward GVC shocks across core, peripheral, and CEEC economies. The aggregate response at the producer-price level is disinflationary and concentrated in the backward channel, supporting the discipline-on-prices hypothesis. A marked PPI–HICP wedge emerges in peripheral economies, where producer-level gains do not reach consumers, while forward linkages feed demand-pull pressures on consumer prices in both core and CEEC suppliers.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了1995年至2023年间参与全球价值链（GVC）如何影响欧盟的通胀。利用局部投影方法，我们追踪了生产者价格和消费者价格通胀对总体、后向及前向GVC冲击的动态响应，覆盖核心经济体、外围经济体及中东欧国家（CEEC）。生产者价格层面的总体响应呈通缩效应，且集中于后向渠道，支持了价格纪律假说。在外围经济体中，出现了显著的PPI-HICP缺口，生产者层面的收益未能传导至消费者，而前向联系则在核心经济体和CEEC供应商中均对消费者价格产生需求拉动型压力。
title: GVC participation and inflation in the European Union
title_zh: 欧盟全球价值链参与度与通货膨胀

abstract: This paper studies the behavior of Katz–Bonacich centrality and key-player intercentrality in linear–quadratic network games when spillovers are strong. Understanding this regime is both theoretically important and empirically relevant in environments where interactions are intense. We show that as spillovers become large, Katz–Bonacich centrality converges (up to scale) to the Perron eigenvector, while intercentrality diverges at the same rate for all nodes and becomes dominated by a common leading component. As a result, first-order proportional differences in intercentrality—normalized by the common divergent scale—vanish near the critical threshold. Rankings based on lower-order differences in intercentrality, or on post-removal activity and welfare levels, need not collapse and may remain stable even arbitrarily close to the boundary.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了在溢出效应较强时，线性二次网络博弈中Katz–Bonacich中心性与关键参与者间中心性的行为。理解这一机制在理论上具有重要意义，并且在互动密集的环境中具有实证相关性。我们证明，随着溢出效应增大，Katz–Bonacich中心性（按比例）收敛于Perron特征向量，而间中心性对所有节点以相同速率发散，并受一个共同的领先成分主导。因此，在临界阈值附近，以共同发散尺度归一化后的间中心性的一阶比例差异消失。基于间中心性低阶差异或基于移除后活动与福利水平的排序，则不必崩溃，并且即使在边界任意接近的情况下也可能保持稳定。
title: How to determine key players when spillovers are large
title_zh: 溢出效应显著时如何识别关键参与者

abstract: In sub-Saharan Africa, population growth coupled with weak or missing markets for clean energy means that the absolute number of people relying on woodfuels for cooking is growing. Charcoal, which has distinctly different environmental and economic implications from firewood, has become one of the most consumed fuels in the region. However, among rural populations, the drivers and consequences of charcoal use remain under-studied. We examine rural woodfuel dynamics in Malawi, a majority rural country with high poverty, rapid population growth, lagging economic development, and abundant but rapidly declining forest resources. We examine how household energy transitions are influenced by concurrent demographic, economic, and land use changes. Using four waves of national household surveys and satellite-derived forest cover datasets, we investigate trends in household energy consumption, identify factors driving rural household fuel choices, and characterize geographic patterns of forest cover loss during 2004–2020. During this time, the share of rural households using charcoal grew from 3.9% to 13.4%. Rural households that are smaller, headed by younger individuals, and are asset-rich but land-poor had greater odds of using charcoal compared to firewood, indicating that rural livelihood dynamics have important consequences for household energy transitions. Several protected areas have experienced > 20% forest cover loss since 2001, characterized by geographic patterns consistent with unsanctioned woodfuel extraction. These findings emphasize a renewed need for integrated natural resources, energy, and livelihoods management strategies. Our insights provide information for policy makers to better predict and understand the continued growth of charcoal’s popularity in Malawi and similar contexts.
abstract_zh: 在撒哈拉以南非洲，人口增长与清洁能源市场的薄弱或缺失并存，导致依赖木燃料做饭的绝对人口数量持续增加。木炭，因其与薪柴在环境和经济影响上存在显著差异，已成为该地区消费量最大的燃料之一。然而，在农村人口中，木炭使用的驱动因素及其后果研究仍显不足。我们以马拉维为研究对象，这是一个以农村人口为主的国家，面临高贫困率、快速人口增长、经济发展滞后以及森林资源丰富但迅速减少的挑战。我们探讨了家庭能源转型如何受到人口、经济和土地利用变化同步影响。利用四轮全国性家庭调查数据和卫星获取的森林覆盖数据集，我们分析了2004年至2020年间家庭能源消费的趋势，识别了影响农村家庭燃料选择的因素，并刻画了森林覆盖损失的地理格局。在此期间，使用木炭的农村家庭比例从3.9%上升至13.4%。相较于薪柴，规模较小、户主较年轻、资产丰富但土地匮乏的农村家庭更倾向于使用木炭，这表明农村生计动态对家庭能源转型具有重要影响。自2001年以来，多个保护区经历了超过20%的森林覆盖损失，其地理格局与未经许可的木燃料开采特征相符。这些发现强调了对自然资源、能源和生计管理进行综合策略的迫切需求。我们的研究为政策制定者提供了信息，以更好地预测和理解马拉维及类似背景下木炭普及度持续增长的趋势。
title: Do coupled population, economic, and land use dynamics explain household energy transitions in Malawi?
title_zh: 马拉维家庭能源转型是否可由人口、经济与土地利用的耦合动态解释？

abstract: The traditional deadweight-loss (DWL) formula rests on a usually unstated, strong assumption: that all other markets are undistorted. We extend the partial-equilibrium DWL formula to cases where the surplus in other markets is non-zero. It involves an additional term of the same order of magnitude as the DWL; this term does not go to zero even when the directly affected market is small relative to the rest of the economy. In examples, we show that the DWL may get the sign of the surplus change wrong when a substantial share of the economy is monopolized or subject to commodity taxes.
abstract_zh: 传统的无谓损失（DWL）公式基于一个通常未明说的强假设：所有其他市场均无扭曲。我们将局部均衡的DWL公式扩展到其他市场剩余非零的情形。该扩展涉及一个与DWL同数量级的额外项；即使直接受影响的市场相对于经济整体规模很小，这一项也不会趋于零。通过实例，我们表明当经济中相当大比例被垄断或受商品税影响时，DWL可能错误地判断剩余变化的符号。
journal: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
source_issue: Journal of Economic Behavior & Organization, Volume 250
title: A new partial-equilibrium approach to approximating the welfare effects of market power and taxes
title_zh: 市场势力与税收福利效应近似的一种新局部均衡方法

abstract: We study a (rent-seeking) contest in which some players form syndicates and compete collectively, while others compete individually, to win a prize (or rent). A syndicate competes, as a single entity, with the other contestants to win the prize. The organizer of a syndicate chooses the syndicate’s effort level. The members of a syndicate share both the cost of effort and the prize (if it wins), according to the syndicate’s sharing rule. We first examine the profitability of being a syndicate member, assuming that the sizes of the syndicates are exogenously given. Then we consider the endogenous formation of syndicates and its effect on prize (or rent) dissipation. We show that, for any given number of players, there is a unique equilibrium size for the syndicate when only one syndicate is formed, and unique equilibrium sizes of the syndicates when two syndicates are formed. We also show that the endogenous formation of syndicates is beneficial both to the syndicate members and to the singletons, and the endogenous formation of syndicates reduces prize dissipation, compared with the individual (rent-seeking) contest.
abstract_zh: 我们研究一种（寻租）竞赛，其中部分参与者组成辛迪加并集体竞争，而其他参与者则单独竞争，以赢得奖品（或租金）。一个辛迪加作为一个整体与其他参赛者竞争以赢得奖品。辛迪加的组织者选择该辛迪加的努力水平。辛迪加成员根据其分配规则，共同分担努力成本和奖品（若获胜）。我们首先考察成为辛迪加成员的盈利性，假设辛迪加的规模是外生给定的。随后，我们考虑辛迪加的内生形成及其对奖品（或租金）耗散的影响。我们证明，对于任意给定的参与者数量，当仅形成一个辛迪加时，存在唯一的均衡规模；当形成两个辛迪加时，存在唯一的均衡规模。我们还表明，辛迪加的内生形成对辛迪加成员和独立参与者均有益，并且与个人（寻租）竞赛相比，辛迪加的内生形成减少了奖品耗散。
journal: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
source_issue: Journal of Economic Behavior & Organization, Volume 250
title: Endogenous syndicate formation in (rent-seeking) contests
title_zh: （寻租）竞赛中的内生辛迪加形成

abstract: The share of young Australians reporting poor mental health has risen sharply over the past two decades, a pattern mirrored across many high-income countries. A central question is whether this reflects a genuine deterioration in underlying mental health or shifts in how different birth cohorts report their symptoms. Using 22 years of nationally representative longitudinal survey data from Australia (2002–2023), we construct a predicted mental health index from respondents’ socioeconomic characteristics, childhood conditions, physical health, life events, and financial circumstances, and compare it against self-reported mental health to isolate cohort-specific reporting differences. We find that the answer is both, namely, that younger cohorts apply lower thresholds when reporting distress, reflecting greater willingness to acknowledge poor mental health, and underlying mental health has genuinely deteriorated among recent cohorts, particularly females. Adjusting for cohort-specific reporting thresholds flattens the apparent rise in poor mental health, though a deterioration remains. After adjustment, the age gradient steepens, revealing that poor mental health peaks in mid-life, a life-cycle pattern that is obscured in raw self-reports. Our findings underscore the importance of accounting for reporting heterogeneity when interpreting mental health trends and planning health services.
abstract_zh: 过去二十年间，澳大利亚年轻人中报告心理健康状况不佳的比例急剧上升，这一现象在许多高收入国家同样存在。核心问题在于，这是否反映了潜在心理健康的真实恶化，抑或是不同出生队列在报告其症状方式上的差异。利用澳大利亚2002年至2023年间22年的全国代表性纵向调查数据，我们根据受访者的社会经济特征、童年条件、身体健康、生活事件及财务状况构建了一个预测心理健康指数，并将其与自我报告的心理健康状况进行比较，以分离出特定队列的报告差异。我们发现答案两者兼有，即较年轻的队列在报告心理困扰时采用了较低阈值，反映出他们更愿意承认心理健康不佳，同时近期队列（尤其是女性）的潜在心理健康确实出现了恶化。调整队列特定报告阈值后，心理健康不佳的表观上升趋势有所平缓，但恶化现象依然存在。调整后，年龄梯度变得更加陡峭，揭示出心理健康不佳在中年达到顶峰，这一生命周期模式在原始自我报告中并不明显。我们的研究结果强调了在解读心理健康趋势及规划卫生服务时，考虑报告异质性的重要性。
title: The good old days? Mental health across birth cohorts
title_zh: 美好的旧时光？不同出生队列的心理健康

abstract: Geopolitical tensions have reshaped international trade and investment flows in recent years. This column uses data on the worldwide affiliates of European multinationals over 2010-2020 to study how these firms are restructuring their foreign networks. Foreign network restructuring has transitioned from expansion to contraction over this period, with an increasing share of episodes involving nearshoring, friendshoring, or both. Crucially, network contractions are not associated with higher home-country activity, contrary to expectations. By contrast, network expansions are shown to boost parent activity and domestic networks.
abstract_zh: 近年来，地缘政治紧张局势重塑了国际贸易与投资流动。本文利用2010至2020年间欧洲跨国公司全球分支机构的数据，研究这些企业如何重构其海外网络。在此期间，海外网络重构已从扩张转向收缩，涉及近岸外包、友岸外包或两者兼有的案例占比日益增加。关键在于，与预期相反，网络收缩并未与母国活动的增加相关联。相比之下，网络扩张则被证明能促进母公司活动及国内网络的发展。
title: Multinational restructuring, friendshoring, and home country activity
title_zh: 跨国重组、友岸外包与母国经济活动

abstract: The White House Faith Office is expanding federal support for religious organisations. Can government policy change how religious citizens are, and what does blurring the line between church and state do to attitudes and polarisation? Exploiting the staggered rollout of ‘faith-based initiatives’ across US states from 1996 to 2009, this column shows that church attendance rose sharply among Protestants, new faith-based organisations multiplied, and social views hardened against abortion and homosexuality, while the rest of the population continued to secularise.
abstract_zh: 白宫信仰办公室正在扩大对宗教组织的联邦支持。政府政策能否改变宗教公民的信仰状态，而模糊教会与国家界限又会对态度和极化产生何种影响？利用1996年至2009年间美国各州“信仰倡议”分阶段推行的自然实验，本专栏显示，新教徒的教堂出席率显著上升，新兴信仰组织数量倍增，社会观念在堕胎和同性恋问题上趋于强硬，而其余人口则继续世俗化。
authors: Jeanet Bentzen, Alessandro Pizzigolotto, Lena Sperling
title: Government support of religion strengthened religiosity and divided America
title_zh: 政府对宗教的支持强化了宗教虔诚并加剧了美国社会分裂

abstract: Despite rapid expansion of farmland transfer in rural China, the quality of contractual governance often fails to keep pace, raising the question of whether spatial consolidation arrangements can promote more complete contract terms. This study examines how coordinated land transfer promotes the standardization of farmland rental contracts within China’s three-rights separation framework. Drawing on primary household survey data from 1101 farming households across four counties in Guizhou Province, this study documents a robust positive relationship between the degree of spatial contiguity in transfer arrangements and the level of contract standardization. Mediation analysis applying the KHB decomposition method reveals that this effect is transmitted primarily through two operational channels: economies of scale and technology adaptation through mechanization adoption. Heterogeneity analysis further reveals that the standardization effect concentrates among operators with greater financial capacity, in regions with stronger market connectivity and irrigation infrastructure, and in villages where collective governance is comparatively weak.
abstract_zh: 尽管中国农村土地流转规模迅速扩张，契约治理质量却往往未能同步提升，由此引发一个问题：空间整合安排能否促进更完整的契约条款？本研究考察在“三权分置”框架下，协调性土地流转如何推动农地租赁契约的标准化。基于贵州省四个县1101户农户的入户调查数据，研究发现流转安排的空间连片程度与契约标准化水平之间存在稳健的正向关系。采用KHB分解法的中介分析表明，这一效应主要通过两条运行渠道传导：规模经济与机械化采纳所引致的技术适应。异质性分析进一步揭示，标准化效应集中于资金能力较强的经营主体、市场连通性和灌溉基础设施较好的地区，以及集体治理相对薄弱的村庄。
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: How does coordinated land transfer promote the standardization of contracts?
title_zh: 协调土地流转如何促进合同标准化？

abstract: This paper examines how participants from representative surveys in Germany and the United States (N = 2,685) prefer to redistribute a consumer food dollar across supply chain actors, including farmers, how willing they are to support and pay for redistribution, and which attitudes drive each of these preferences. We find widespread support for increasing farmers’ share of food expenditures, primarily driven by the belief that farmers lose from trade and lack alternative trading partners. In contrast, support and willingness to pay for specific interventions are rather shaped by ideological beliefs about markets. These findings demonstrate that folk economic beliefs, such as zero–sum thinking, play a central role in shaping food dollar redistribution. Building on this insight, we develop policy recommendations to help policymakers navigate what we term the Food Dollar Trap: the tension between calls to improve farmers’ incomes and concerns about food affordability.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了来自德国和美国的代表性调查参与者（N = 2,685）如何倾向于在供应链参与者（包括农民）之间重新分配消费者食品支出中的每一美元，他们支持并愿意为这种再分配支付的程度，以及哪些态度驱动了这些偏好。我们发现，广泛支持提高农民在食品支出中的份额，这主要源于一种信念，即农民在贸易中受损且缺乏替代贸易伙伴。相比之下，对具体干预措施的支持和支付意愿则更多地受到关于市场的意识形态信念的影响。这些发现表明，民间经济信念，如零和思维，在塑造食品美元再分配中发挥着核心作用。基于这一见解，我们提出了政策建议，以帮助政策制定者应对我们称之为“食品美元陷阱”的困境：即改善农民收入呼声与对食品可负担性担忧之间的张力。
title: The food dollar trap: attitudes driving public support for redistribution
title_zh: 食品美元陷阱：态度如何驱动公众对再分配的支持

abstract: Hidden fees can distort consumer decision-making. In response, regulators historically have (a) improved disclosure to make fees more salient or (b) standardized products to restrict what fees can be charged. We use Chilean administrative data and a multi-stage natural experiment to separately identify the effects of disclosure and standardization on repayment. We find that disclosure reduces delinquencies by 13.7 percentage points (40%) and default by 1.68 percentage points (98%), whereas standardization has no effect. We find no effect on initial loan terms, suggesting that disclosure’s effects are specific to repayment behavior: specifically, disclosure improves borrowers’ understanding of their credit obligations.
abstract_zh: 隐藏费用可能扭曲消费者的决策。为此，监管机构历来采取两种措施：（a）改进信息披露，使费用更加显眼；或（b）标准化产品，限制可收取的费用类型。我们利用智利的行政数据及一个多阶段自然实验，分别识别信息披露与标准化对还款行为的影响。研究发现，信息披露能将逾期率降低13.7个百分点（降幅40%），并将违约率降低1.68个百分点（降幅98%），而标准化则无显著效果。我们未发现对初始贷款条款的影响，这表明信息披露的效果特定于还款行为：具体而言，信息披露增强了借款人对自身信贷义务的理解。
title: Removing the fine print: Disclosure, standardized products, and consumer outcomes
title_zh: 去除细则：信息披露、标准化产品与消费者结果
